ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Specific
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-nop.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[Convert\\]\\:\\:FromBase64String.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-noni.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-nop.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*iex.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ep.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*bypass.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Enc.*")) OR ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*powershell.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*reg.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*add.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\run.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\wow6432node\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\run.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\policies\\\\explorer\\\\run.*"))) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*bypass.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-noprofile.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-windowstyle.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*new\\-object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*system\\\.net\\\.webclient.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.download.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*iex.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Net\\\.WebClient.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.Download.*"))) AND  NOT ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(New\\-Object\\ System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient\\)\\\.DownloadString\\(\\'https\\:\\/\\/community\\\.chocolatey\\\.org\\/install\\\.ps1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(New\\-Object\\ System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient\\)\\\.DownloadString\\(\\'https\\:\\/\\/chocolatey\\\.org\\/install\\\.ps1\\'\\).*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Write\\-ChocolateyWarning.*")))
